Achieve the perfect balance of blazing fast speed and energy efficiency, taking your gaming experience to the next level. Ultra-Fast PCIe® 4.0 With the latest 4-channel PCIe® 4.0/NVMe1.4 controller and 3D TLC NAND memory, experience even faster sequential speeds and improved random access performance. Enjoy rapid data access and lightning-fast response times for demanding tasks. Enhanced Stability DRAM-less design reduces power consumption and minimizes heat generation, ensuring improved SSD stability. Enjoy shorter load times and uninterrupted gameplay for a smoother, more comfortable gaming experience. New High-Efficiency Heatsink Design The newly designed aluminum heatsink covers the entire SSD board and features a high-efficiency black anodized coating. It effectively controls temperature during data transfers, preventing thermal throttling (speed limit activation to prevent thermal runaway.) for consistent high performance. *The original heatsink cannot be disassembled. When you mount this product on a desktop computer, make sure there is enough space for this M.2 SSD to be installed. This drive cannot be used for laptop computers. EXPAND YOUR PlayStation ® 5 STORAGE Compatible with PS5™ confirmed by Nextorage* NEM-PA series with built-in heatsink fits into the expansion slot of PS5 console or PS5 Digital Edition console. Increasing the storage capacity of PS5 allows you to download, copy, and start PS5 and PS4™ games from the M.2 SSD storage. Check your device compatibility ‣ *Tested in PS5 (version:23.02-08.20.02) This is not a product developed under the license program of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. Compatibility and performance are not guaranteed for all game titles. How to add an M.2 SSD to a PS5™ PS5 Model CFI-1XXX ‣ PS5 Model CFI-2XXX (model group – slim) ‣ ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY FOR LONGER LIFETIMES Dynamic SLC Dynamic SLC caching technology accelerates frequently accessed data by extending the life of TLC NAND. Wear Leveling By evenly distributing write and erase operations across the entire memory block, it prevents overuse of specific areas. Our proprietary advanced wear leveling algorithm efficiently maximizes the lifespan of the NAND flash. Error correction algorithm (LDPC) The SSD controller has a high precision error correction algorithm “LDPC (Low Density Parity Check)”, which has advanced detection and correction technology for random bit errors that occur during reading and protects the data from corruption. RELIABLE STORAGE Perfectly tested This product is write/read tested at high temperatures specified by Nextorage before shipment, In addition to functional tests. 5-Year limited warranty Warranty and product support valid for 5 years from the original date of purchase or before writing the maximum TBW (Total Bytes Written) Specifications Model/Capacity* NEM-PAC4TB / 4 TB NEM-PAC2TB / 2 TB NEM-PAC1TB / 1 TB *Capacity is based on 1 TB = 1 trillion bytes, and 1 GB = 1 billion bytes. A portion of the memory is used for system files and may vary.
